artifact.dataset: GolfDB authors preprocessed clip 0, TRAIN in registered outer fold 1

selection: Fixed five frame indices before new diagnostic rendering; no event labels or accuracy-based selection implied

reference_plan.visible_coordinates: Continuous image-edge pixels: x in [0,width], y in [0,height]; pixel centers at 0.5 through width-0.5/height-0.5
reference_plan.nonvisible_coordinates: Both coordinates null; do not invent occluded joint locations
reference_plan.blinding: Clean reference page contains no model coordinates; scorer requires manual model-blinded and independent attestations plus annotator identifier
reference_plan.coverage: All 33 anatomical indices at every registered frame, including explicit unreviewed entries; report every reference state and model abstention
reference_plan.uncertainty: A single operator reference is not ground truth; future accuracy study needs independent repeat annotations, disagreement analysis and broader source/view coverage

metrics.pixels: Per-joint radial Euclidean pixel error, mean/median/RMSE/max among eligible visible reference points, with scored and abstention counts
metrics.normalized: Same radial error divided by independently annotated shoulder-midpoint to hip-midpoint length in the SAME frame; missing/degenerate reference scale remains unavailable
metrics.engineering_filter: Use saved presence-filtered landmarks and visibility >=0.5; do not tune this floor from the pilot
metrics.identity: Any multiple-pose observation anywhere in the sequence abstains on all eligible reference points
metrics.independence: One source recording; never report selected frames as independent golfers or population evidence

limitations: The existing pose output was already observed in execution009, so this pilot is not a blinded model-evaluation registration
No manual reference coordinates have been created or accuracy results measured at registration
Operator handedness/mirror/identity assumptions and reencoded timestamps do not establish anatomical correctness or original recording time
Projected coordinate arithmetic and visual overlays do not validate physical joint angles, calibrated 3D or coaching
A future empirical study requires a separate prospective media/reference agreement protocol before model/threshold selection
